warnings: 2 indications are pending prove-up and not included in the calculation.
2 indications have no valid plate location.
5 repaired soil-side locations keep their corrosion rate in UPᵣ (API 653 §4.4.5.1 Note 1); tick "cause of corrosion removed" on a repair where that applies.

lines: 14 MFL indications recorded, 10 proven corrosion, 2 awaiting prove-up.
Bottom plates: MRT 2.67 mm at O<sub>r</sub> = 10 yr (minimum 2.54 mm) — acceptable.

items.action: Repair by patch plate, weld build-up or plate replacement per API 653 Section 9 and re-test (vacuum box) before return to service.

items.finding: 2 MFL indications have not been proven up.
items.action: Prove up the remaining MFL indications by UT / VT and update the evaluation.

lines: Course 1: minimum 9.45 mm vs t-min 9.99 mm — Evaluate per §4.3.2.
Course 2: minimum 10.72 mm vs t-min 7.83 mm — OK.
Course 3: minimum 9.12 mm vs t-min 5.16 mm — OK.
Course 4: minimum 7.54 mm vs t-min 3.20 mm — OK.
Course 5: minimum 5.94 mm vs t-min 2.50 mm — OK.

items.finding: Shell course 1: 3 readings are below the t-min for their location (minimum 9.45 mm).
items.action: Evaluate the corroded area per API 653 §4.3.2: the average thickness over the averaging length must be at least t-min, and the least thickness at least 60 % of t-min; otherwise repair or re-rate the fill height.

items.finding: The minimum shell readings support a maximum product fill height of 10.968 m (course 1), below the 11.582 m maximum fill height.
items.action: Reduce the maximum fill height to 10.968 m or repair course 1.

items.finding: 1 fixed roof reading is below t-min (Q4-E 1.90 mm).
items.action: Repair or replace the thin roof plates (API 653 §4.2.1.2: any hole through a plate, or an average below 0.09 in over any 100 in², requires repair or replacement).

lines: Rim seal — US EPA: not compliant.

items.finding: 1 floating roof deck plate is below t-min: F2.
items.action: Repair or replace the thin deck plates.

items.finding: Pontoon P7 contains liquid or is leaking.
items.action: Drain, locate and repair the leaks; re-test the pontoons.

items.finding: Rim seal does not meet US EPA 40 CFR 60 Subpart Kb (tanks built or modified 24 Jul 1984 – 4 Oct 2023) / 40 CFR 63 Subpart WW: Visual inspection.
items.action: Repair or empty and remove from service within 45 days (§60.113b(a)(2)); defects found with the tank emptied must be repaired before refilling.

items.finding: Rim seal does not meet Canada SOR/2025-88 — Reduction in the Release of VOCs (Storage and Loading of Volatile Petroleum Liquids) Regulations: Secondary seal — widest gap; Visual inspection.
items.action: Install a temporary vapour control system within 15 days and complete the repair within 180 days (s. 100(1)(b)).

items.finding: Nozzle N3 neck minimum 4.47 mm is below the minimum 5.08 mm.
items.action: Replace the nozzle neck or evaluate it for the design conditions.

lines: 1 observation rated poor: Drainage away from the tank.

items.finding: Drainage away from the tank (200°–240°): Ponding against the chime on the low side; grade slopes toward the tank.

lines: Shell settlement: acceptable (R² 0.98, tilt 55 mm towards 207°).
Edge settlement: 12 stations measured, worst 77 % of allowable at station 8 (nde required).

items.finding: Edge settlement over 75 % of the allowable at station 8.
items.action: Examine the shell-to-bottom and bottom welds in the settled areas visually and by MT or PT; VT of welds within 12 in of the breakover.

warnings: B.3.2 scope: the permissible values do not consider ridges, low nozzles or other discontinuities near the bottom, fold lines through roof columns, or combined shell and edge settlement; B.3.2.2 applies to API 650 carbon and stainless steel tanks in its diameter range. Otherwise a rigorous engineering assessment is required (B.3.2.4).
